messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team, quick heads-up — Mariner Analytics asked for a focused privacy + security checklist before their CISO call next Tue. They want answers on SOC2 scope, DPA clauses, and embedding retention.
Ethan R (SE): I can take the technical questions re: embeddings. Do we have a short policy snippet we can share for retention + purge?
J. Lee (Security): Short answer: default retention for embeddings is 30 days for hosted customers unless they opt into retention disable. For Dedicated/Private it's customer-configured. We should surface KMS usage and access controls too.
Alex (AE): CISO is specifically nervous about PII in embeddings — wants to know if we do automated PII suppression or redaction and if logs contain embeddings.
Ethan R (SE): We don't persist embeddings into logs. Embeddings are stored per-tenant encrypted-at-rest with KMS. For PII: we recommend a client-side filter step; we also have a built-in opt-in PII scrubber in beta.
Maria (CS): Can someone paste the exact wording for the DPA section about subprocessors and data residency? Customer asked for copy/paste language.
J. Lee (Security): Use this snippet: "Redwood Inference processes Customer Data solely to provide inference services. Subprocessors are listed in Appendix A; Customer may request additional subprocessors or controls via SOC2/DPA contact." (we should attach full appendix in the followup)
Ethan R (SE): Also adding a quick config example for retention toggles so Mariner's infra team can see it:
```
# retention config (hosted)
embeddings.retention_days: 30  # set to 0 to disable retention
embeddings.kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inf/key1
logs.persist_embeddings: false
```

Maria (CS): Nice — I'll share that. Alex, can you confirm whether the contract allows 0-day retention for hosted customers or if we need a Dedicated offering?
Alex (AE): For standard hosted plans we can offer retention=0 under an addendum; it's common enough but requires legal signoff. I'll flag that as a commercial ask.
onboard-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence folder link: https://redwood.app/evidence/mariner-171350
J. Lee (Security): For the SOC2 scope question — Mariner only needs "inference and management plane" scoped. We'll exclude our infra org-level controls unless they ask. I'll draft a one-pager on scope.
Maria (CS): Customer also wants to know the timeline for DPA + addendum review. Typical cycle?
Alex (AE): 5-7 business days for legal + CS if no redlines. If they request retention=0 we should add 2-3 days.
Ethan R (SE): One more technical FYI for the CISO call: if they plan to run heavy embedding workloads we recommend Dedicated for throughput and isolation. That also simplifies retention controls.
Maria (CS): Action items: (1) Ethan — share the config snippet and a short note on PII handling (done here, but expand). (2) J. Lee — SOC2 scope one-pager (ETA today EOD). (3) Alex — commercial note for retention=0 addendum and legal ping. I'll compile and send prep deck to Mariner.
Alex (AE): I'll set up the CISO call and include legal. Tentative slot Tue 10:00 PT.
Maria (CS): Perfect. Any objections to sharing the evidence folder link pre-call? I think it's helpful.
J. Lee (Security): Fine to share read-only link. Keep sensitive items gated until they sign the DPA.
Ethan R (SE): If useful I can join the call for a 10-15 min tech walkthrough of embedding controls.
Maria (CS): Please do. Thanks everyone — I'll push a short prep note to the Mariner thread and tag you. :thumbsup:
